items.title: Accounts Receivable Software Features Finance Teams Need
items.summary: Key Takeaways Effective AR software centers on four jobs: smart invoicing, automated collections, AI-powered cash application, and self-service customer portals. DSO improvement tends to track how much of your AR workflow you automate more than which single tool you own. Broader automation coverage generally correlates with larger reductions. Smart invoicing auto-generates and auto-charges recurring invoices and is typically one of the quicker, lower-difficulty capabilities to stand up. Automated collections uses behavior-based email, SMS, and call reminders and generally takes a bit longer to implement, at medium setup difficulty. The core value is speeding up cash collection without turning every past-due reminder into a relationship risk.
